summary: Authors may use AI tools but must declare and describe any use for generating text or images, translation, or analysing data. Minimal, non-generative uses such as basic spelling checks or minor formatting need no declaration. AI tools cannot be listed as authors, and declarations go in the acknowledgements, cover letter, methods section or figure captions, with failure to disclose potentially leading to disqualification.

evidence.quote: generative AI tools such as ChatGPT should not be listed as authors on any submitted content.
